prompts.androgynous: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: concealed skin source layers for a painted game character. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an 840x560 transparent sheet, right-facing torso on the left and left-facing torso on the right. Image 2 is the approved full anatomy painting, STYLE/ANATOMY REFERENCE ONLY. Image 3 is a guide mask: white pixels mark the only repair area. Replace every magenta patch in image 1 with complete painted skin matching the neighboring original color, soft directional shading and brush texture. Restore the torso under the removed arm, the pelvis and upper-hip skin, and shoulder surface. These are TWO armless, headless torso-and-pelvis cutouts, not whole figures. Remove all remnants of hands, forearms and arm contour strokes in the repair zone. Keep the breast/chest shape, waist, rounded buttock, under-buttock shadow, exterior contour, neck opening, exact position, same two views and sheet framing. Preserve the original outside the repair zone. No flat fill, no rectangular/triangular patches, no internal seam lines, no extra limbs, no text. Keep the buttock curve and painted shadow coherent, and skin fully opaque inside the shape with a crisp antialiased outside edge. Transparent background. Preserve the sheet aspect ratio and the cutout registration; do not crop, center or rescale individual cutouts. Anatomy: androgynous. Match the original neutral gray sculptural painted skin exactly, without adding color.
